title.narrative: Increased resilience and self-help capacities for reconstruction of livelihoods and sustained nutritional food security in South Sudan

description.narrative: This project has the overall objective to promote opportunities for youth and women employment, and to introduce diversified livelihoods through demonstrations of business activities that may include, although not limited to, agro and food processing and micro-enterprise trade.
